notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary attribute ownership services and lifecycle boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. It covers ownership query, ownership checks, acquisition, If Available acquisition, release and divestiture flows, negotiated confirmation and cancellation, invalid-handle boundaries, and resignation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ownership query, acquisition, divestiture, release, cancellation, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador ownership callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador ownership-service and FederateAmbassador ownership-callback declarations
